token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your API key:
1. Open [API Keys](https://console.perplexity.ai/project/keys) in the Perplexity API Console.
2. Create a new key.
3. Copy the key and paste it here.

perplexity_ai_cancel_agent_response.label: Cancel Agent Response
perplexity_ai_cancel_agent_response.description: Request cancellation of a running Agent API response.

responseId.label: Response ID
responseId.description: Response id ("resp_..."), from Create Agent Response.

perplexity_ai_create_agent_response.label: Create Agent Response
perplexity_ai_create_agent_response.description: Generate a response with the Perplexity Agent API, optionally using web search and other tools.

input.label: Input
input.description: The question or task for the model.

model.label: Model
model.description: Model id in provider/model form, e.g. "openai/gpt-6-luna" or "perplexity/sonar". Use List Models for the available ids. Set this, Models or Effort.

models.label: Models
models.description: Fallback chain of up to 5 model ids, tried in order until one succeeds. Takes precedence over Model.

effort.label: Effort
effort.description: Preset effort level that picks the model, system prompt and search settings, e.g. "fast", "low", "medium" or "high", optionally pinned as "name@<version>". Cannot be combined with Profile.

profile.label: Profile
profile.description: Saved, versioned configuration to run with. Cannot be combined with Effort.

tools.label: Tools
tools.description: Array of tools the model may call, each an object with a "type": web_search, image_search, finance_search, people_search, fetch_url, function, sandbox, mcp or connector, e.g. [{"type":"web_search"}]. Each tool call is billed. Omit for no tools.

toolChoice.label: Tool Choice
toolChoice.description: Tool choice strategy, e.g. {"type":"image_search"} to force image search.

skills.label: Skills
skills.description: Array of skills available to the model, e.g. [{"type":"custom","name":"<skill name>"}] for a skill from List Skills. Selecting any skill enables the billed sandbox tool.

previousResponseId.label: Previous Response ID
previousResponseId.description: Id of a completed response from this action or Get Agent Response, to continue that conversation.

maxOutputTokens.label: Max Output Tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate. Required for anthropic/* models.

maxSteps.label: Max Steps
maxSteps.description: Maximum research loop steps. Defaults to 1 for a direct model, or the effort level's own value.

reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning Effort
reasoningEffort.description: How much the model reasons before answering, for models that support it.

languagePreference.label: Language
languagePreference.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language to answer in, e.g. "en".

background.label: Background
background.description: "true" returns at once with status "queued"; poll with Get Agent Response. Defaults to "false", which waits for the answer.

store.label: Store
store.description: "false" hides the response from Get Agent Response. Defaults to "true".

perplexity_ai_get_agent_response.label: Get Agent Response
perplexity_ai_get_agent_response.description: Retrieve an Agent API response by its id.

responseId.label: Response ID
responseId.description: Response id ("resp_..."), from Create Agent Response.

perplexity_ai_list_agent_response_files.label: List Agent Response Files
perplexity_ai_list_agent_response_files.description: List the files an Agent API response produced.

responseId.label: Response ID
responseId.description: Response id ("resp_..."), from Create Agent Response.

perplexity_ai_list_models.label: List Models
perplexity_ai_list_models.description: List the models available to the Agent API.

skillId.label: Skill ID
skillId.description: Skill id from List Skills or Create Skill.

revision.label: Revision
revision.description: Revision token from List Skill Revisions. Defaults to the active revision.

perplexity_ai_get_skill_download_url.label: Get Skill Download URL
perplexity_ai_get_skill_download_url.description: Get a short-lived URL to download a skill bundle.

skillId.label: Skill ID
skillId.description: Skill id from List Skills or Create Skill.

revision.label: Revision
revision.description: Revision token from List Skill Revisions. Defaults to the active revision.

perplexity_ai_list_skill_revisions.label: List Skill Revisions
perplexity_ai_list_skill_revisions.description: List the revisions of a skill.

skillId.label: Skill ID
skillId.description: Skill id from List Skills or Create Skill.

perplexity_ai_list_skills.label: List Skills
perplexity_ai_list_skills.description: List the skills in your Perplexity project.

batchId.label: Batch ID
batchId.description: Batch id ("batch_..."), from Create Batch or List Batches.

perplexity_ai_create_batch.label: Create Batch
perplexity_ai_create_batch.description: Start a batch over an uploaded JSONL file.

inputFileId.label: Input File ID
inputFileId.description: File id ("file_...") from Upload Batch File.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency Key
idempotencyKey.description: Unique key; repeating it returns the original batch.

fileId.label: File ID
fileId.description: File id ("file_..."), from List Batch Files.

perplexity_ai_get_batch.label: Get Batch
perplexity_ai_get_batch.description: Get a batch's status and results file.

batchId.label: Batch ID
batchId.description: Batch id ("batch_..."), from Create Batch or List Batches.

fileId.label: File ID
fileId.description: File id ("file_..."), from Upload Batch File, List Batch Files or a batch's output_file_id.

perplexity_ai_list_files.label: List Batch Files
perplexity_ai_list_files.description: List batch input, output and error files.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.description: "batch" for uploads or "batch_output" for files batches wrote.
